headline: Bancolombia forecasts 2.4% GDP growth for Colombia in 2027
summary: Bancolombia projected Colombian economic growth of 2.4% for 2027, cautioning that inflation will likely remain above the central bank's target and fiscal consolidation will pose significant challenges.
why: Bancolombia is the country's largest financial institution, and its macro outlook shapes corporate credit and domestic investment expectations.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Leading bank research projects modest 2.4% expansion with persistent fiscal and inflation headwinds.
